title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Climate Resilient and Environmentally Sustainable Solutions Somalia/Somaliland (CRESS Somalia/Somaliland) programme will work in Banadir, Somalia and Somaliland. It aims to contribute to Concern Somalia’s Green Graduation and Climate Resilience thematic programmes, and the goal of the grant is to provide inclusive climate resilient and environmentally sustainable livelihood opportunities to vulnerable populations in Banadir. The programme will support over 160,290 people living in extreme poor households including those headed by women, households with disabled members and young people. This will be done through households receive asset/capital transfer to make investment in productive assets in diversified employment activities, households linked to formal financial services and barriers are addressed, environmental restoration and damage mitigation measures are in place and increased awareness on environmental protection and conservation.. Developing preparedness plans and disaster risk reduction strategies in order to protect key infrastructure assets from the impacts of climate change; are key to this outcome. Activities, such as, setting up early warning systems, addressing governance issues and promoting awareness Promoting disaster preparedness and the links to climate change adaptation at various levels of government as well as at community level are eligible for a Rio Marker scoring of 2.
